units.title: Consolidate inline engine types into src/types/

sessions.title: BaseEngine Adoption — Pipeline + Physics Engines (Top 20)

smart_config.role: Refactoring Specialist + Engine Architecture + Physics Domain Expert

sessions.intent: The 20 most critical engines adopt the BaseEngine contract. They get standardized execute(), validate(), and getCapabilities() methods. This proves the pattern works at scale before broader rollout. Physics outputs remain bit-for-bit identical.

units.title: Adopt BaseEngine in 9 pipeline engines
units.description: Each pipeline engine (PrintToProgram, Turning, MultiAxis, MillTurn, EDM, Grinding, Laser, Waterjet, QuoteToShip) extends BaseEngine. Existing methods become the body of execute(). validate() wraps existing Zod validation. getCapabilities() returns metadata. All existing exports and method signatures preserved. REGRESSION: Run each pipeline with a reference input before and after, diff outputs.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: Pipeline outputs identical pre/post (snapshot diff for each)

units.title: Adopt BaseEngine in 11 physics/core engines
units.description: Adopt in: SpeedFeedOrchestratorEngine, KienzleForceModelEngine, ChatterStabilityLobeEngine, ThermalWearCouplingEngine, ToolDeflectionEngine, SurfaceFinishPredictorEngine, ToolLifeEngine, CuttingForceEngine, CuttingTemperatureEngine, StabilityLobeEngine, ToolWearProgressionEngine. Same pattern as U-CONT03. CRITICAL: Run /physics-verify after changes. AtomicValue outputs must be bit-for-bit identical. Machinist-grade: a shop-floor operator running these engines gets the same forces, temperatures, and tool life predictions.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: Machinist-grade: force/temp/life values identical for reference inputs
